notes.title: UNDEFEATED: Genesis TGS 2024 Trailer & Demo Gameplay!
notes.content:
We will be exhibiting at TOKYO GAME SHOW 2024, so we have released the latest trailers for UNDEFEATED: Genesis, the “TGS2024 Trailer” and “TGS2024 Demo Gameplay”.

[h2]UNDEFEATED: Genesis - TGS2024 Trailer[/h2]

[previewyoutube=0vvp3tdWzLY;full][/previewyoutube]
This trailer is the latest demo trailer that has evolved from “MathChief's Game Expo 2023 Trailer” and “Announcement Trailer” that were released last year, and it includes content that is being released for the first time. Please enjoy some of the vast world of UNDEFEATED: Genesis, including the newly added “devastated city” and “new combat elements”.
[table]
    [tr]
        [th]MathChief's Game Expo 2023 Trailer[previewyoutube=hclO1awtWLM;leftthumb][/previewyoutube][/th]
        [th]Announcement Trailer - The MIX Next 2023[previewyoutube=OmTto6ULNd0;leftthumb][/previewyoutube][/th]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[h2]UNDEFEATED: Genesis - TGS2024 Demo Gameplay[/h2]

[previewyoutube=Ss2NtIIOq5A;full][/previewyoutube]
You can watch a video of the latest demo on display at TGS2024.
This is the first time we've shown gameplay from this title, so we're really looking forward to seeing everyone's reactions.

[hr][/hr]
At TGS2024, we will be exhibiting a demo that includes the content of the video we have just announced, so please be sure to play it if you are visiting the venue.（We are giving away stickers and postcards to those who have tried out the game.)

For information about TGS2024 exhibits, please see here.

notes.title: UNDEFEATED: Genesis will be exhibited at Tokyo Game Show 2024!
notes.content:
We will exhibit “[url=https://en.undefeated-game.com/][b]UNDEFEATED: Genesis[/b][/url]”, a superhero action RPG currently in development, at “[url=https://tgs.nikkeibp.co.jp/tgs/2024/en/][b]TOKYO GAME SHOW 2024[/b][/url]”, one of Japan's largest gaming events, to be held at Makuhari Messe from September 26 to 29.

At TGS2024, you will be able to try out the demo, which has been greatly updated since BitSummit Drift, at the booth [[b][color=orange]09-W27[/color][/b]] of the publisher, [url=https://x.com/ChorusWorldwide][b]Chorus Worldwide[/b][/url].

In the demo, you will be able to freely explore a devastated city, which is a new adding from the nature-rich fields of the past and also features new combat elements and a new experience of helping others as a superhero! Please come to TGS and play the game!

notes.title: UNDEFEATED: Genesis is coming to PS5!
notes.content:
[b]Dear superhero fans who are eagerly awaiting 'UNDEFEATED: Genesis',[/b]

Hi! This is the "UNDEFEATED" dev team.
Thank you for your continued support of 'UNDEFEATED'. It truly means a lot to all of us.

We are very excited to be able to make this announcement to you today to announce that the latest title in the UNDEFEATED series, which we are currently developing, 'UNDEFEATED: Genesis', will be released not only on PC (Steam), but also on PlayStation 5.
The publisher is the same as the Steam version, Chorus Worldwide.

Along with the decision to release the game on PS5, we have decided to change the logo for UNDEFEATED: Genesis.
We promise to deliver the best superhero experience to you, so please look forward to it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42738004/a90e4dbe6154bfa87d0bc53d4970ec99c5565282.jpg[/img]
In addition, the free superhero game 'UNDEFEATED', which has been downloaded over 2 million times worldwide and is loved by everyone, will also be released on PS5.

[previewyoutube=g3rkF0VPWKQ;full]https://youtu.be/g3rkF0VPWKQ?si=JvsAf3BLNsBLre7k[/previewyoutube]
The PS5 version of UNDEFEATED includes 4K support and the latest updates that will be released for the PC (Steam) version, and you can play it for [u][b]FREE[/b][/u].
Experience the invincible superhero not only on PC (Steam), but also on PS5!

[h2]PlayStation Store[/h2]
[list]
[*]UNDEFEATED: Genesis (Scheduled to launch in 2026): [url=https://store.playstation.com/concept/10011831]https://store.playstation.com/concept/10011831[/url]
[quote=author]Don't forget to add your wishlist on the PlayStation Store![/quote] [*]UNDEFEATED (Free): [url=https://store.playstation.com/concept/10011751]https://store.playstation.com/concept/10011751[/url]
[/list]
[h2]About UNDEFEATED[/h2]
'UNDEFEATED' was originally a student project from Vantan Game Academy in Japan that was released for free on Steam in August 2019. As of September 2024, it has been downloaded over 2 million times worldwide.
The aim of the game was to make players feel like a real superhero, flying freely around a city and wielding awesome powers to save the inhabitants with a simple and intuitive control method.
'UNDEFEATED' has received high praise from many superhero fans and gamers, especially from international players.

After graduating from Vantan Game Academy, the development team gained experience in the gaming industry and then reunited at Indie-us Games in Osaka, Japan, where they are currently working on 'UNDEFEATED: Genesis,' the latest installment in the UNDEFEATED series, with a planned release in 2026.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1116960/UNDEFEATED/

[h2]What's 'UNDEFEATED: Genesis'?[/h2]
'UNDEFEATED: Genesis' is a superhero action game set on a massive alien planet.
Developed in Unreal Engine 5, the game builds on 'UNDEFEATED' and the feeling of being a superhero, but is vastly scaled up in scope, technology, and story. In 'UNDEFEATED: Genesis', players will experience flying across a huge environment, developing and using astounding superpowers, and experiencing a rich storyline.
The game is being developed with the intention of delivering a true "superhero experience" to fans and aims to make players feel the same sense of power as heroes in comics and manga.

'UNDEFEATED: Genesis' takes place in the same universe as 'UNDEFEATED' and narratively serves as its prequel.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2088020/UNDEFEATED_Genesis/
